text: Unused items can be sent back within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
To start a return, open Orders, choose the item and click Return. Print the prepaid label and drop the parcel at any post office.
Return labels are free for defective items. For change-of-mind returns, $5 is taken off the refund to cover the label.
Returns FAQ: this page collects common questions about returns, how long returns take, return labels, refunds and the return window.
Once your parcel reaches our warehouse, your refund lands on your original payment method in 5 to 10 business days.
Prefer store credit? Choose it when you send an item back and the credit is issued instantly, instead of waiting for the bank.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express arrives the next business day.
Standard is free on orders over $50, otherwise $4.99. Express costs $14.99.
Delivery news: how long standard delivery and express delivery take this season, our delivery partners, delivery zones and delivery updates.
We send parcels to the EU and the UK. They take 7 to 14 days, and import duties are paid by the customer on arrival.
Open Orders and press Track. The link starts updating within 24 hours of dispatch.
You can cancel until the parcel is dispatched: Orders, then Cancel. After dispatch, send it back instead.
Moving? Contact support before dispatch and we will update the delivery address.
Orders help: everything about your order, how to track your order, cancel your order, change your order and order emails.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay.
Payment declined at checkout? Check that the billing address matches your card, then try again. Some banks block online purchases by default.
Payments overview: which payment methods you can pay with, why a payment can fail, payment security and payment problems.
Forgot your password? Use Forgot password on the login page; the link expires in 1 hour.
To use a different email address, go to Settings, then Profile, and confirm the new address from your inbox.
Account help: how to change your account email, change your password, account settings and account login problems.
Acme Plus costs $9 per month or $90 per year.
Acme Plus members get free express delivery on every order and early access to sales.
Cancel your membership any time; benefits last to the end of the paid period, with no partial refunds.
Acme Plus overview: what Acme Plus includes, what Acme Plus costs and how to join Acme Plus.
Electronics have a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage, like drops or spills, is not covered.
To make a claim, open a support ticket with the order number and a photo of the defect.
Warranty overview: what the warranty covers, whether accidental damage is covered, warranty claims and warranty terms.
Gift cards never expire and cannot be exchanged for cash.
We do not match prices from other stores.
Chat support is open 8am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday.
